p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, establishing a company, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the current official sources, then you read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, customs duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): tariffs and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): Standards, labelling and health regulations of this country for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and duties on imports into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check if a platform has not been marked by a regulator before entrusting your money
p.espaces.rg_note: A website opens in the language of your choice: use the translation function of your browser, or for a document, « Understand a document ».
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not make customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Card (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): Customs, Taxes, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on importation into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer’s forwarder.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller unloads the ship; after that, risks and costs pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers to the destination, the buyer pays the import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such listings are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn any money from these links: you compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash payment in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees shown before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the sum: fees + exchange rate – a worse rate than the market rate is a hidden cost source.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN …).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identification document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to unlock a prize, package, loan, or visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customers. Easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is approved in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated product.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Let your customers know the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect the rights of customers: Clear prices including taxes, return policy, warranty, privacy.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
p.espaces.ds_plat: Wholesale platforms (private, not linked to 24/24 ONE WORLD)
